definitions: An infection of the intestines resulting in severe diarrhea with the presence of blood and mucus in the feces, accompanied by fever and abdominal pain.
Any of various diseases characterized by inflammation of the intestines, especially the colon, with symptoms such as abdominal pain, tenesmus, and frequent stools containing blood and mucus.
examples: Many soldiers suffered from dysentery during the war.
The child was diagnosed with amoebic dysentery.
Poor sanitation can lead to outbreaks of dysentery.
